month_theme: Back in Panama — first real action week

key_dates.event: First full day back — action mode begins
Gap year decision now 3+ weeks pending — follow up if no news by Monday

notes: Portugal is done. The vacation earned, the break taken. This week marks the hard pivot to execution. The gap year decision is the gating factor for detailed planning — but both paths (Baret Scholars or independent) share the same Phase 1 groundwork: C++, scuba, glider project. Start moving on all three regardless of the decision. Career plan update is the foundation everything else is built on — it cannot wait another week.
